title: Sign evaluation of a sparse Fourier hypothesis
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a sparse Fourier hypothesis on $n$ Boolean coordinates, define its associated Boolean function by assigning to each input $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ the sign $+1$ when the hypothesis value at $x$ is nonnegative, and the sign $-1$ when that value is negative.
hypotheses_covered: a sparse Fourier hypothesis on $n$ Boolean coordinates
